# Step 2.223, one league gate: the lane's note

## Every way into a league before this step (layer 1, item 1)

- **Pages** (`app/[league]/(site)`, `admin`, `score`): `loadLeaguePage` → `resolveLeagueRequest` (`apps/web/src/server/league-gate.ts`), which passes `mayOpenLeague`. A signed-in person cost one more read (`accessOf`) at a hidden league than at a missing one.
- **Invitation pages** (`app/[league]/invitation`) and `acceptHeldInvitationAction`: `invitationRequest` (`invitation-request.ts`), `requestContext` only, no `mayOpenLeague` (an invitee must reach a draft league). Not changed here; see "Left".
- **League API routes** under `app/api/v1/leagues/[leagueId]/` (twelve files; the plan says eight): all through `leagueEndpoint` → `resolveLeagueApi`, which checked only "there and not in the bin". Then `mayOpenLeague` was applied by the endpoint itself in four: `scoring`, `my-team`, `staff-numbers`, `games/*/snapshot`. Not in eight: `games/*/commands`, `not-started`, `reopen`, `rosters`, `session`, `state`, `format`, `copy` (a visitor 401 and a stranger 403 at a hidden league; `commands` 400 to `{}`).
- **`'use server'` files**: every league action goes through `loadLeaguePage` first (settings, fixture import, games, divisions, bin, admins, season settings, standings, venues, people, teams, scorekeepers, and the schedule builder through `perform-action.ts`), so `mayOpenLeague` holds. `sign-in/actions.ts`, `sign-in/local-actions.ts` and `useAnotherAccountAction` reach no league.
- **Both "my team" actions** (`features/team-pages/my-team-actions.ts`, choose and clear): `loadLeaguePage(…, 'site')`, so `mayOpenLeague` holds.

## Done in layer 1 (commits 5dfbd13b, e25227e1)

- `resolveLeagueApi` (`apps/web/src/server/league-api.ts`) reads the person's access once, then the address, then `mayOpenLeague`: hidden is 404 before any endpoint reads a body (so the commands route's 400 to `{}` is gone for a hidden league). It returns `holder`; `leagueEndpoint` passes it on, and the `scoring`, `my-team`, `staff-numbers` and `snapshot` routes use it instead of a second read. Their own `mayOpenLeague` checks stay.
- Both gates read access for a missing league too (`readAccessOfNoLeague`, `noLeagueId`, in `league-gate.ts`): T-449. T-450 and S-126 in `docs/specs/v1/decisions-pending/`; T4 has a line.
- `apps/web/src/server/league-gate-hidden.test.ts`: draft, suspended, binned v a missing short name and id (all twelve letters), as visitor, stranger, another league's admin, coach, member (a captain), at every page kind and all twelve endpoints' parts, both modes: same answer and same reads. Each of the four gate lines broken by hand: a test failed each time. `trackerWorld().contextPastTheGate` tests an endpoint's own refusal past the gate.

- **Must fix first: the scorer's waiting taps.** A scorer signed out in another tab of a draft league now gets 404 from `games/*/commands`; `reasonOfStatus` in `apps/web/src/features/tracker/tracker-controller.ts` (line ~530) reads 404 as `unknown-game`, a "game gone" loss, not `signed-out`. The tracker must keep the taps and ask for sign-in (S-126), with a browser test. Or the lead decides tracker endpoints answer every visitor 401 before the league is looked up (the same for a missing league, so nothing is given away).
- `npm run check` rule in `scripts/`: a `'use server'` file must call `loadLeaguePage` (or say why not, as sign-in does) and a route under `app/api/v1/leagues` must call `leagueEndpoint` before `jsonBody`/`request`. Prove it fails on a copy with the line removed.
- `test:web` (`scripts/check-web-shell.mjs`): byte-for-byte pages, twelve routes by GET and POST (`{}` and a valid body), both "my team" actions, for the leagues and people above; a draft league's scorekeeper still scores in a browser.
- Not covered: the invitation pages and `acceptHeldInvitationAction` do not pass `mayOpenLeague` (on purpose); the accept action sends a hidden league's visitor back to its invitation page but a missing one's home: an answer that differs. Below the gate `myAccess` stops earlier for a missing league (T-449 says so).
